title: 몇 개예요? 세는 말: 개, 명, 분, 잔, 병, 권, 장, 마리, 대
objective: By the end, you can choose the right counter for common things and say how many using 한, 두, 세, 네 (number + counter, e.g. 커피 두 잔).
summary: Learn nine everyday Korean counters for things, people, drinks, books, paper, animals and vehicles.

task.title: Use the right counter
task.line: Choose or write the counter (and number) that fits each thing.

words.exampleMeaning: I ate three pieces of bread this morning.
(At a restaurant) There are two of us. / Table for two.

words.meaning: cup, glass (counter for drinks in a cup)

words.example: 편의점에서 물 두 병 사 왔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I bought two bottles of water at the convenience store.

words.meaning: volume, copy (counter for books and notebooks)
words.example: 이번 달에 책을 두 권 읽었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I read two books this month.

words.meaning: sheet (counter for flat things: paper, tickets, photos)
words.exampleMeaning: Please take a photo of us.

words.example: 친구 집에 고양이가 네 마리 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My friend has four cats at home.

exercises: Choose the right counter: ① 강아지 세 (마리 / 명) ② 종이 다섯 (권 / 장) ③ 소주 두 (병 / 권)
Write the number in Korean: ① 우유 (1) ____ 병 ② 학생 (3) ____ 명 ③ 사과 (4) ____ 개
Fill in the blank with the polite counter for people: 우리 반에 선생님이 두 ____ 계세요.
You want two cups of coffee. Complete the order: 커피 ____ 주세요.
Read and answer in Korean (number + counter): 가방에 책 두 권하고 공책 한 권이 있어요. 가방에 책과 공책이 모두 몇 권 있어요?
Fix the wrong counter: 버스 세 마리가 왔어요.
answers: ① 마리 ② 장 ③ 병
① 한 ② 세 ③ 네
